newsitem.title: UK: Charter welds businesses in South America.
newsitem.headline: Charter welds businesses in South America.

text.p: UK-based diversified industrial group Charter Plc said Esab do Brasil and Conarco, an Argentine welding equipment producer, had formed a joint venture to create the largest welding business in South America.
Esab do Brasil is owned jointly by Esab, a unit of Charter, which has 61.5 percent, and its local partners.
Charter said results from the joint venture would be consolidated into Charter's accounts.
It said Esab do Brasil's other shareholders had agreed to swap their 38 percent holding in Esab do Brasil for a 62 percent stake in the Conarco group.
Charter would then have a 38 percent holding in each company which would be deemed effective from September 1, 1996.
Charter said net assets of the joint venture would be approximately 32 million stg.
It added that the transaction was not expected to have a significant effect on Charter's shareholder funds.
